content.text:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I’m excited to apply for the Senior Frontend Engineer role. My background is centered on React, TypeScript, design systems, and product-facing web applications, and I’m drawn to the opportunity to help build a customer-facing SaaS platform with strong UI foundations and a thoughtful user experience.

At BrightLayer, I led a design system migration used across four product squads, which gave me hands-on experience creating reusable frontend patterns that can scale across teams. I also focused on performance optimization, reducing page load time by 28 percent through bundle and rendering improvements. I enjoy the balance of writing maintainable code, improving user experience, and making frontend systems easier for other engineers to build with.

I’ve also worked closely with product and design in practical, iterative environments. At Northline Labs, I partnered directly with design on customer-facing workflow improvements and built experimentation dashboards for product and growth teams. Through UI experiments, I helped improve signup conversion by 11 percent, which reinforced how valuable careful instrumentation, collaboration, and iteration can be.

I’d welcome the chance to bring my React and TypeScript experience, design system focus, and product-minded approach to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,  
Alex Martin
